README:

The software is a reverse-engineered version of a commercial software
published more than 30 years ago. The current copyright holder is
SoftVoice, Inc. (www.text2speech.com)

Any attempt to contact the company failed. The website was last updated in
the year 2009. The status of the original software can therefore best
described as Abandonware.

As long this is the case I cannot put my code under any specific open source
software license. Use it at your own risk.
